title: The polynomial Freiman–Ruzsa conjecture
abstract: Formalizes Marton's polynomial Freiman–Ruzsa conjecture by the entropy method, including the characteristic-two bounds with exponents twelve and nine, the bounded-torsion theorem with an explicit exponent, and quantitative consequences for affine dimension and approximate homomorphisms. The supporting development builds entropic Ruzsa distance, multidistance, conditional entropy, and additive-energy machinery. This optimized import reuses the pooled Zhang–Yeung entropy and kernel library in place of duplicate upstream modules while preserving all six closed headline statements.

informal.Marton.pfr_conjecture: A nonempty finite set A of doubling at most K in an abelian group of exponent two is covered by fewer than 2 K^12 cosets of a finite subgroup no larger than A.
informal.Marton.pfr_conjecture_nine: Strengthens the characteristic-two covering theorem to fewer than 2 K^9 cosets of a finite subgroup no larger than A.
informal.Marton.torsion_pfr_conjecture: In an abelian group of exponent m at least two, a nonempty finite set of doubling at most K is covered by fewer than m K^(256 m^3 + 1) cosets of a subgroup no larger than A.
informal.Marton.weak_pfr_int: A nonempty finite set of doubling at most K in a finite-rank free abelian group has a subset of relative size at least K^(-34) and affine dimension at most (80 / log 2) log K.
informal.Marton.homomorphism_pfr: A map between finite abelian groups of exponent two whose additive defects lie in S differs from a homomorphism by a map taking at most |S|^10 values.
informal.Marton.approx_hom_pfr: A map between finite abelian groups of exponent two that is additive on at least a 1/K fraction of pairs agrees with a homomorphism on at least (|G| / (2^144 K^122) - 1) / 2 points.
